line.en:
This project proposes a coastal wellness resort designed specifically to support the recovery and rehabilitation 
of individuals living with Post-Traumatic Stress Disorder (PTSD).
line.ar: فيلا عائلية أُعيد بناؤها حول الضوء والزجاج ولوحة خامات هادئة.

brief.en:
The design integrates evidence-based healing 
principles with holistic, non-pharmacological therapies, including Ocean Therapy, Meditation Therapy, and Art 
Therapy, to create a restorative environment that nurtures physical, mental, and spiritual well-being. Emphasizing strong connections to nature, the resort incorporates healing gardens, water features, abundant natural 
light, and open, calming spaces that promote relaxation, resilience, and social interaction. Through thoughtful 
spatial planning, biophilic design strategies, and a tranquil coastal setting away from urban stressors, the project aims to provide a safe and supportive sanctuary where individuals can rebuild confidence, manage emotional challenges, and enhance their overall quality of life
brief.ar: أراد العملاء بيتًا ينفتح على الحديقة ويمنح الهدوء من أول خطوة. أعدنا بناء المخطط حول القوس، ولطّفنا مدخل البيت، ووزّعنا الخشب والحجر والكتان في كل مكان.
